description: HTTP-backed IReportSource for viewer-facing remote report endpoints. It loads metadata, renders snapshots, and exports PDF/CSV/XLSX by posting ReportViewer request DTOs.

constructor.signature: RemoteReportSource(HttpClient httpClient, string reportId, string basePath = "api/reports")
constructor.description: Creates a remote source for one report id. The base path is trimmed and defaults to api/reports.
